definition.mechanism_unknown_reason: This is a shared-purpose definition at the input-to-adapter-bearing-fragment stage. No common mechanism for the entire selected units is asserted. Individual uses retain their supported mechanisms: ChIPmentation includes solute-removal washes followed by Tn5 tagmentation; Drop-seq delegates Nextera XT transposome tagmentation. Null does not mean either individual reaction mechanism is scientifically unknown, nor does this relation assert that the mechanisms are equal or different.

dna_fragmentation_and_adapter_introducti.scope_note: Purpose-level retrieval of transformations that produce sequencing-adapter-bearing DNA fragments, across distinct materials and local operation boundaries. The ChIPmentation member includes both cold Tris washes and the on-bead reaction; the Drop-seq member retains all four independent cDNA reactions through their immediate outputs. Shared purpose covers these entire supplied transformations without deleting the preparatory handling or asserting a common complete mechanism. Observed coupled transposome fragmentation/tagging is retained on uses; simultaneity and enzyme identity are not defining requirements at this level. A wash alone, neutralization alone or downstream amplification alone does not establish the required conversion. Product end chemistry, quantitative recovery and barcode linkage require individual evidence. This category establishes neither experimental substitution, compatibility, ancestry, literature novelty nor an executable reaction recipe.

definition.information_effect: Changes DNA fragment boundaries and adds adapter sequence that supplies an interface to subsequent sequencing-library processing. definition.mechanism_unknown_reason: This is a shared-purpose definition at the input-to-adapter-bearing-fragment stage. No common mechanism for the entire selected units is asserted. Individual uses retain their supported mechanisms: ChIPmentation includes solute-removal washes followed by Tn5 tagmentation; Drop-seq delegates Nextera XT transposome tagmentation. Null does not mean either individual reaction mechanism is scientifically unknown, nor does this relation assert that the mechanisms are equal or different.
